text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hello-lo! I'm Ines Fujin, and here's to our brand-new partnership!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Just so you know, I've got a few part-time jobs I balance. I'll make sure to schedule my shifts around our training, so don't hold back and whip me into shape!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna give both racing and work everything I've got—that's how I'll repay my family for supporting me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
